**Draft only. Publication is held until native recording, Finish, save and reopen verification passes.**

This update adds live local-model topic tracking, source-linked conversation tools, and fixes to questions, answers, memory use and downloads.

## Downloads

- **Apple Silicon Macs:** `Oats-arm64.dmg`.
- **Intel Macs:** `Oats-x64.dmg`.
- **Linux x86-64:** `Oats-x86_64.AppImage`, `Oats-amd64.deb`, `Oats-x86_64.rpm` or `Oats-linux-x64.tar.gz`.
- **Checksums:** `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Oats needs macOS 12 Monterey or later. Mac packages are not notarized by Apple. After dragging Oats to Applications, macOS may require Open Anyway in System Settings > Privacy & Security.

## What is new

### Topics while you talk, and after Finish

- Topics have a short name and a description that grows with the conversation.
- With a supported local writing model, Oats revisits the last six minutes about every two minutes. It can revise a boundary or return to an earlier topic.
- At Finish, the writing model reads the conversation and cuts the saved record into topics before naming them. If the model cannot provide usable cuts, Oats keeps the tracker's topics.
- The model gets a rough topic-count hint to reduce excessive splits. The hint now applies to local and cloud routes.

### Tools for conversations you keep

- Open a recurring topic's dated history.
- Collect source-linked passages in working sets, with your own notes and order.
- Compare the stored topics, marks and open questions of two conversations. This comparison does not generate an AI account of their differences.
- Save literal searches and filters for later.

### Recording and setup

- Show or hide recording details explicitly, with separate Transcript and Questions tabs.
- Search stays available while recording.
- The setup tour's controls now work with fictional examples, without saving or sending those interactions.
- Parakeet Ultra on the Apple Neural Engine is an optional speech model, with preceding audio context. It is not the default.

## Fixes

- English question detection no longer treats a question word anywhere in a sentence as a question.
- Short yes/no replies are interpreted with their question. An ordinary negative answer no longer opens a search just because it contains "no".
- Question cards wait while a reply is being transcribed, including engines without partial text.
- Cloud-checked conversation links keep different subjects separate instead of chaining them into one large group.
- The local writing server no longer accumulates an extra cache of past prompts. Live topic naming uses its own writing server instead of unloading the question classifier.
- Summaries explain local model-capacity failures and avoid futile unchanged retries.
- Switching away from local speech stops the automatic Turbo download.
- Keyboard focus, Escape/Enter behavior, small controls and agent-overlay readability have fixes.

## Known limits

- Topic cuts can still be wrong, too frequent or delayed. The local live tracker typically trails the conversation by about one to two minutes in the measured replays.
- The topic-count hint was measured with local models. Its effect on cloud-model accuracy remains unmeasured.
- Local writing models still have capacity limits on long summaries. This update does not promise summaries of any length.
- Native recording/save/reopen verification is pending for this draft. The full 99-minute capture and optional Neural Engine path are not verified end to end.
- Intel Mac and Linux packages are built in CI. A successful package build is not proof of runtime behavior on those platforms.
- Unmerged UI drafts are not included.

## Privacy

On the local route, transcription and writing run on this computer. Models and runtime helpers can require downloads.

With a cloud provider selected, audio can go to OpenAI for speech, and transcript content goes to the selected providers for writing and topic checks. At Finish, the record-topic cut reads the whole transcript in parts of up to 6,000 words. It adds no new provider destination.

Automatic question search is separate: by default, a confirmed "I don't know" can send the question text to the configured search host. Turn auto-search off in Settings to make searches manual.

Tell people before recording. Some places require everyone's consent.
